title: Gay Witch Hunt
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael Scott unintentionally outs Oscar as gay, leading to office tension and awkward attempts at support. Meanwhile, Jim and Pam share a complicated moment as Pam confirms she is engaged to someone else. Michael's misguided efforts to understand and address homosexuality in the workplace culminate in a public display of support that is met with mixed reactions. Jim is promoted to a permanent position and nicknamed 'Big Tuna,' while Dwight humorously tests a 'gay-dar' device. The episode explores themes of acceptance, misunderstanding, and workplace dynamics around sexual orientation.

main_threads.thread: Michael's accidental outing of Oscar and the resulting office conflict and awkward attempts at reconciliation.

evidence.snippet: Michael: No! That is the fun of this place. I call everybody "faggie".
Toby: OK I think Oscar would just like if you used "lame" or something like that.
Toby: OK, I am telling you, Oscar is an actual homosexual.
Oscar: No, I'm not gay. And I don't understand why anyone would think, that I'm gay… if… Uh… yeah I'm gay.
Toby: OK, Michael, are you aware that you ousted Oscar today?
Oscar: Yes I'm gay. And I didn't plan on sharing that part of my life with you today, so, whatever.
